replay_method: Re-derive X_k from its adjacency definition, without using the primary theorem statements as assumptions. Check P7-freeness, source validity, forcing reachability, connected-profile injection, all-four activity, and structural-carrier closure.

graph_structure: Bipartition A={s1,z} union L and B={s4} union R is exact.
s1 is adjacent to every B-side vertex and no A-side vertex.
H=G[L union R union {z}] is a chain graph because N(l_i)={r_1,...,r_i} and N(z)={r_1,...,r_{k-1}} are nested.
P7_free: Any induced P7 containing s1 has a chord because s1 is universal to the B side and the path contains at least three B-side vertices.
An induced P7 avoiding both s1 and s4 would lie in chain graph H, which is P5-free.
If a P7 avoiding s1 contains s4 with B as the minority side, two distinct nonconsecutive A-side vertices would have to be nonneighbors of s4, but z is the only such A-side vertex.
Hence, up to reversal, the only possible role sequence is r_t-z-r_j-l_i-s4-l_h-r_c.
source_i_vi: No outside vertex is complete to S: L sees only s4, R sees only s1, z sees neither.
Axiom (iv) is vacuous because Y0 has one vertex.
L has source list {1,2,3}, R has {2,3,4}, z has [4].
forcing_reachability: Optional forcing is F subseteq {l_2,...,l_{k-1}}, all fixed to color 1.
L is stable and all l_i are nonadjacent to same-colored seed s1.
Every R already sees color 1 from s1, so forcing more L vertices to 1 does not change any R source-color mask.
Every subset state has explicit extension: all L=1, all R=4, z=2, seed colors fixed.
No Z0/Z1 or connectivity repair occurs.
connected_profile_injection: l_k remains live and is complete to R, so the dynamic chain stays connected; [z] attaches to r_1,...,r_{k-1}.
L and R are role-distinguished by their source/fixed-color masks.
Every surviving l_i has exactly i neighbors in R.
Therefore the reduced profile recovers the omitted/forced subset F exactly.
There are 2^(k-2) distinct profiles inside one connected Q_ALL block.
four_color_activity: Color 1 occurs in live L palettes and color 4 occurs in live R palettes; colors 2 and 3 occur on both sides.
Permanent live anchors l_1,l_k witness R2 colors 1,2,3 on same-side nonedges.
Permanent live anchors r_1,r_k witness R2 color 4.
Hence there is no common globally missing color and all four colors are future-query active.
structural_carrier: After removing fixed seed vertices, every nonfixed graph state is an induced subgraph of the original chain graph H on L union {z} versus R.
Fixing a vertex changes only fixed status and deletes its color from neighbors' current lists; deletion preserves induced-subgraph status.
Every active list is a subset of fixed palette [4].
Chain graphs are permutation graphs, so bounded-total-color List Coloring applies with total color set size four.
R1 and R2 are exact singleton-list modifications followed by the bounded-4 permutation-graph List Coloring decision.
A constructive coloring follows by at most four decision trials per active vertex.
B2B1-deleted independent pieces remain represented by reconstruction receipts.
